title: Delete metadata whose owner no longer exists
description: Removes metadata rows whose post, term, user or comment no longer exists. What counts as an orphan is defined per type in docs/DECISIONS.md D-0026, and is deliberately conservative: a row is only an orphan when the table WordPress itself joins against has no matching row.
breaks: Metadata belonging to deleted content is removed; a plugin that recreates content by id would no longer find it
